flags.name: AI Parler
flags.description: Parler chat with embedded ThingWorx AlwaysOn Transport only (ConnectAndBind + Send + ReceiveMessage). No Composer event for user turns. See docs/architecture/agent-alwayson.md

EmptyStateMedia.description: Optional Media Entity image for an empty conversation

HideHeader.description: When true, hide the title region (default: compact UI)

HeaderTitle.description: Header title (visible only when HideHeader is false)

HeaderSubtitle.description: Deprecated: not rendered; kept for existing imports

ThingworxWsUrl.description: Transport: full AlwaysOn WebSocket URL (ws:// or wss://). If empty, derived from page location + /Thingworx/WS

AppKey.description: Transport: application key (e.g. short-lived key before ConnectAndBind)

AgentThingName.description: Transport: AIAgent Thing name. Phase F default: Send → SubmitUserPrompt on ParlerGateway uses this; legacy path (UseSubmitUserPromptOnConversation false): ParlerStreamToRemoteThing on agent. See docs/architecture/agent-alwayson.md §2.

UseSubmitUserPromptOnConversation.description: Transport: Phase F default true — Send invokes SubmitUserPrompt on ParlerGateway (conversationId). False = ParlerStreamToRemoteThing on agent; extension still enforces AgentThreadDataTable ownership for conversationId on both paths.

ConversationId.description: Phase F: transient ParlerGateway Thing name — single AlwaysOn bind target (same value as conversationId / AgentThreadDataTable row key). Not a persistent Conversation RemoteThing. Default Send: SubmitUserPrompt on this gateway; uncheck UseSubmitUserPromptOnConversation for §2.1 ParlerStreamToRemoteThing on agent (debug/legacy).

HostScopeJson.description: Optional Mashup HostScopeJson (UTF-8 JSON text: key + context). Read synchronously on Send; uplink as hostContext per CONTRACTS/API_CONTRACT.md and docs/architecture/host-context.md.

LoadHistoryOnBind.description: After ConnectAndBind, invoke ParlerGateway.GetConversationHistoryJson and hydrate thread (docs/ui/load-history.md). Set false for empty thread / manual LoadHistoryJson only.

HistoryServiceName.description: Gateway service name for history JSON (default GetConversationHistoryJson if empty).

HistoryMaxItems.description: Max stream rows for GetConversationHistoryJson (QueryStreamData). Default 500; server clamps 1..20000. Newest rows are fetched first, then shown in chronological order.

HistoryLoadingMessage.description: Banner while loading history; empty uses built-in default.

ConnectAndBind.description: Transport: WebSocket + Auth + Bind to ConversationId (ParlerGateway name); ReceiveMessage on that name. Run only after Mashup binds AppKey, ConversationId, and AgentThingName (runtime aborts if any are empty). Set ThingworxWsUrl or use a page host that resolves to /Thingworx/WS.

DisconnectAlwaysOn.description: Transport: close AlwaysOn client opened by ConnectAndBind

ApplyLiveJson.description: Push one wire JSON string (fallback when not using embedded ReceiveMessage, or hybrid testing)

ResetChat.description: Clear thread state in the widget

LoadHistoryJson.description: Advanced: replace thread from one-shot JSON (docs/ui/AI_PARLER_HISTORY.md). Ignored when busy or approval gate open; bumps epoch vs in-flight GetConversationHistoryJson.
